description: Author, activate, and run the Facebook safe comment draft mission until it stops at the human review gate without auto-posting.
humanGoal: Inspect Facebook Reels, detect non-product videos, draft a safe comment, and stop for human review without posting.
operatorNote: Never publish the comment. The only acceptable terminal gate is a human review hold.
commandInputRef: Appreciate the storytelling here. The pacing and framing kept it easy to follow.

authoringContext.rawRequirement: Do not auto-post comments. On Facebook Reels, when the current video is judged non-product, open the comments UI, type a safe draft comment, and stop at a human review gate. Product videos or ambiguous detections must not create an auto-post path.
authoringContext.safeExecutableRequirement: Open Facebook Reels in a governed real Chrome session, classify the current reel with vision.productPresence.v1, branch only to non-product safe-draft flow, type the approved draft text without submit, persist runtime proof, and end in a mandatory human review gate.
